Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be 
 performed on an (1/4) annually bases as indicated by M3 in the above title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Assy, accepted by general 
 manager eng Mohmed Kamel 
 Afify and approved by eng. Gaber Mohmed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power 
 station & MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the pump electrically
Isolate the heating steam and all 
 valves (delivery & suction)
Mechanical isolation
Open the drains
Tools 
and Equipment
Workshop kit 
 (spanners & wrenches)
Screw drivers & gear pullers ... 
 etc
Lubricating oil & general purpose 
 grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Spanner & wrenches
Graphite packing 10 mm
Allen keys
Mobil gear oil
Work to be Carried Out
Check the pump body, foundation & bolt
Check the safety valves
Check the suction & delivery valves
Check the heating system
Check the bearing
Check the pump shafts & housing & impellers
Check the pump diffusers
Check the pump coupling & rubber & bolts
Check the pump stuffing box
Check the pump protection sleeves of the shaft
Assemble the pump after repairing
Adjust the alignment
Check the pump after repairing (running)
Test the all works
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
De-assemble the defective unites
Remove the insulation
Restore all valves to the operating normal position
Clean the area after repairing
